Initial purchasers were granted a 13-day option to acquire up to an additional $75M in principal amount.

The notes will bear interest at 0.25% per annum, payable semi-annually on March 15 and September 15, starting March 15, 2027. The notes mature on September 15, 2031, unless earlier converted, redeemed, or repurchased.

The initial conversion rate is 22.3005 shares per $1,000 principal amount (equivalent to ~$44.84 per share), representing a 40.0% premium over Tenable’s September 10, 2026 closing price of $32.03 per share.

Cash redemption is restricted prior to September 20, 2029, unless outstanding principal falls below $80M (cleanup redemption) or stock price hurdles (130% of conversion price) are met on or after that date.
The transaction settlement is expected on September 15, 2026.
Tenable estimates net proceeds of ~$705.6M ($778.8M if the over-allotment option is fully exercised).

The company intends to allocate the funds as follows: $170.5M to concurrently repurchase ~5.3M shares of common stock at $32.03 per share. $58.1M to fund capped call transactions to mitigate share dilution up to a 100% cap price ($64.06 per share). Payoff of term loans under its senior secured credit facility. Remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes, working capital, and strategic investments.
